description: Risk R-B, stated before anything else because the class name inverts the behaviour: the prompt-mandated Java class for COTRN01C is TransactionAddController, but this program ADDS NOTHING - it VIEWS. Four independent sources say so: app/cbl/COTRN01C.cbl:5 'Function    : View a Transaction from TRANSACT file', README.md:223 '| CT01 | COTRN01 | COTRN01C | Transaction View |', app/bms/COTRN01.bms:2 'CardDemo - Transaction View' and app/bms/COTRN01.bms:79 INITIAL='View Transaction' at POS=(4,30). The mapset corroborates it structurally: of its 56 DFHMDF entries 21 are named and exactly ONE is UNPROT - TRNIDIN at :85, ATTRB=(FSET,IC,NORM,UNPROT) - so a single input-capable field faces twenty output-only ones, which is the shape of a lookup-then-display screen rather than of a data-entry screen. Rule R1 governs the resolution - the name comes from the prompt, the behaviour comes from the source - and practice B4 governs the disclosure, so the divergence is documented here and never silently corrected. expectedWrites is empty, no arm of this case asserts an insert, and the half of the swap that genuinely adds a transaction lives in parity/COTRN02C. WHAT THIS CASE PINS: the first-entry arm at :99-109 entered with nothing selected - the reference fingerprint of this folder, the plain screen paint the other nineteen cases are read against. EIBCALEN is 218, so :94 takes its else arm and :98 copies the passed area over CARDDEMO-COMMAREA. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives at 0, so CDEMO-PGM-REENTER does not hold at :99 and the program sets it at :100 - which is why the echoed context is 1 and not 0, and it is the whole of the ENTER-versus-REENTER decision this case exists to pin in source order (gate G30). :101 then moves LOW-VALUES over the entire 575-byte COTRN1AO and :102 requests the cursor in TRNIDIN. CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED is 16 blanks, so the :103-104 guard 'NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES' is FALSE, PROCESS-ENTER-KEY is NOT performed and no read is issued: TRANSACT is seeded with nothing precisely because the keyed EXEC CICS READ at :269-278 is never reached on this path, and a case that seeded rows it never touches would suggest it had. That leaves exactly ONE send, at :109, and the task ends at the EXEC CICS RETURN of :136-139. SPACES AND LOW-VALUES ARE DIFFERENT BYTES, which is the distinction the twenty-one pinned fields carry. Of them, six are the header POPULATE-HEADER-INFO rebuilds at :245-262, one is ERRMSGO, and the remaining FOURTEEN - TRNIDINO, TRNIDO, CARDNUMO, TTYPCDO, TCATCDO, TRNSRCO, TDESCO, TRNAMTO, TORIGDTO, TPROCDTO, MIDO, MNAMEO, MCITYO and MZIPO - are still the LOW-VALUES of :101 and are encoded as genuine U+0000 runs at their declared widths, not as blanks. The codec renders x'00' as x'00' and nothing here substitutes spaces for it: BMS omits a null field from the outbound datastream and erases a field holding spaces, so the two produce different screens as well as different bytes. THE HEADER, byte for byte from the copybooks: TITLE01O is CCDA-TITLE01 and TITLE02O is CCDA-TITLE02, both PIC X(40) with leading and trailing spaces inside the field, and TITLE02O takes the ACTIVE app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:22 value rather than the commented-out :21 alternative; TRNNAMEO is WS-TRANID 'CT01' at PIC X(04) and PGMNAMEO is WS-PGMNAME 'COTRN01C' at PIC X(08), both from :36-37. CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are PINNED (practice B7) to the same instant case01.json declares, which is also the one the source's own footer at :329 carries: 'MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA' at :245 is non-deterministic, and WS-CURDATE-DATA is only 16 bytes - WS-CURDATE 8 plus WS-CURTIME 8 - so the 21-character intrinsic result is truncated to YYYYMMDDhhmmssss and WS-CURDATE-YY is taken from WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2). Neither thank-you literal is emitted on any path of this program, and the two are not interchangeable: COTTL01Y's CCDA-THANK-YOU is PIC X(40) and names 'CCDA application' while CSMSG01Y's CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU is PIC X(50) and names 'CardDemo application'. THE TWO MESSAGE CHANNELS carry what :91-92 left. MOVE SPACES blanked WS-MESSAGE PIC X(80) and ERRMSGO OF COTRN1AO PIC X(78), and :217 moves the first into the second - an 80-byte sender into a 78-byte receiver, so COBOL loses the two rightmost bytes. Both are all spaces here, so the loss is invisible in the values and would be invisible in a single channel too; declaring them separately at 80 and at 78 is what keeps the truncation observable. ERRMSGO is pinned at 78, never 80. NEXT-TARGET FIELDS, and what they do NOT mean: there is no EXEC CICS XCTL anywhere on this path, so gate G40 is NOT discharged by this case and no XCTL target is invented. nextProgram carries COTRN01C because the task ends at 'EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID)' and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:429-430 binds TRANSACTION(CT01) to PROGRAM(COTRN01C) - the operator's next input returns to this same program - and nextMapset and nextMap carry the COTRN01 and COTRN1A the SEND at :219-225 names. termination is RETURN_TRANSID rather than XCTL, and the two are not interchangeable. STATELESSNESS (rule R6, gate G37): the whole 218-byte area travels in the payload and nothing is held server-side. app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy is 34 + 84 + 12 + 16 + 14 = 160 bytes and the CDEMO-CT01-INFO extension at :53-61 is 16 + 16 + 8 + 1 + 1 + 16 = 58, which is 218 in all; the extension is carried as its own field rather than folded into the 160-byte context all seventeen controllers share, so all 22 fields are pinned and none is left unchecked. A field the passed area does not name keeps what its picture gives it - spaces for PIC X, zeros for PIC 9 - so CDEMO-CT01-NEXT-PAGE-FLG is blank here rather than the 'N' of its VALUE clause at :57, because :98 overwrote WORKING-STORAGE with the caller's bytes. BASELINE PROVENANCE (practice B12): every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED, by structured reading of MAIN-PARA, SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN and POPULATE-HEADER-INFO cross-checked against the copybook byte layouts (app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy), the BMS field contract (app/cpy-bms/COTRN01.CPY - 21 xxxI payload items summing to 416, so the group is 12 + 21 x 7 + 416 = 575 bytes) and the transaction definition in app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD. It was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution: running the legacy programs is empirically impossible in this environment, which AAP section 0.7.6 establishes with eight independently verified blockers, and the change of provenance is escalated as risk R-A rather than absorbed silently. GATES DISCHARGED: G15 (one of exactly twenty cases in parity/COTRN01C), G18 (the diff count must be zero, per module rather than per build), G30 (the :99 decision honoured in source order), G37, G38 (this is the ENTER half of the ENTER/REENTER pair, and because COTRN01C copies no CSSETATY the DFHRED-plus-asterisk highlight applies on neither - so the attribute map is empty rather than absent-by-omission) and G51 (the controller is driven as a plain object, with no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path). Deliberately NOT asserted, because this program or this path has none of them: G32 (zero GO TO), G35 (zero CALL 'CEE3ABD', which is why the return code is 0 and no abend path exists), G39 (no pagination), G40 (no XCTL on this path), G43 (no 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC) and G19/G21/G23 (no TRANSACT row is seeded, so this case pins no record width; case20 pins the 350-byte CVTRA05Y record and the dataset-level no-write proof).
